name: AWS Third Louisa County Campus
summary: AWS withdrew a third Louisa County campus application after public resistance. Two other AWS campuses continued, making this a within-county siting contrast rather than a county without data-center investment.
proposal_description: AWS applied for a conditional-use permit for a third campus concept in Louisa County. The proposal was materially larger than a single building and sat within a county already hosting other AWS development.
site_afterlife: No verified alternative use for the exact proposed site is published here. Other AWS campuses in Louisa County remain separate operating-project observations.
evidence_note: This is not a never-treated county. Any causal design must separate the rejected third campus from other AWS and EdgeCore activity in the same county.
unresolved_questions: Has AWS retained or marketed the 1,370-acre third-campus site?
Were the seven contemplated substations or utility studies cancelled, transferred, or repurposed?
What share of the reported fiscal projection depended on full buildout, incentive assumptions, and timing?
Can future permits distinguish activity at this parcel from AWS's two continuing Louisa campuses?

timeline.title: AWS files for a third campus
timeline.summary: Louisa County materials identify a conditional-use application for a roughly 1,370-acre campus with about 7.2 million square feet of potential building area.

timeline.title: Neighborhood meeting draws substantial scrutiny
timeline.summary: About 100 residents attended a project meeting and raised concerns about scale, substations, roads, water, noise, and proximity to Mineral.

timeline.title: Supervisor schedules a town hall on the proposal
timeline.summary: A county supervisor convened another public forum as scrutiny of the campus and its infrastructure continued.

timeline.title: Mineral and residents oppose the third-campus plan
timeline.summary: Local opposition broadened, including a Mineral Town Council resolution and public pressure on county decision-makers.

timeline.title: AWS withdraws the application
timeline.summary: AWS submitted its withdrawal after community feedback, ending the reviewed third-campus application before a county approval vote.

timeline.title: County records the project in its land-use system
timeline.summary: The county's application database and overview preserve the withdrawal record for continued parcel-level tracking.

timeline.title: Other AWS construction continues to affect county conditions
timeline.summary: Reporting on a separate AWS campus documents ongoing construction impacts, underscoring that Louisa is not an untreated county after the third-campus withdrawal.

county_outcome_context.note: The decision occurred after the county panel's 2024 endpoint, leaving zero full post-decision years. Louisa already had other data-center construction, so future county movements cannot be attributed to the withdrawn third campus without parcel- and project-specific controls.
